notes.title: Animating the Art of War
notes.content:
[h1]The battle[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/3a147d2f307796ee7ac6e1ee35f2d01404d45ea4.png[/img]
We're thrilled to announce our decision to go with variant C, a choice that truly encapsulates the essence and style of our game. It's not just a choice, but a statement - one that resonated profoundly with players in our latest playtest, sparking excitement and anticipation. Variant C doesn't just inform; it captivates and intrigues, setting the stage for an unforgettable gaming experience.

[h1]The Transition[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/306aa86b13299e15e30390a4928ae0948fd96272.gif[/img]

Taking immersion to the next level, we've introduced an innovative image transition feature. It's a visual treat that transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary, moving away from the mundane black screen transitions to a rich, narrative-driven spectacle.

But that's not all. We've seamlessly integrated an endless transition effect, infusing life and motion into the game's universe. Imagine lightning tearing through the skies, smoke curling into oblivion, and an ethereal dance of levitating skeletons and rocks. Witness the fiery aura of the boss's weapon, the mystical glow encircling the priest, and the visceral attack motions of raiders in the heat of battle - all coming together in a mesmerizing, perspective-driven panorama.

[h1]The infinite loop[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/293055f8cda4635bd1e8d05f3bbdc8b4957f9afa.gif[/img]

This captivating scene is more than just an aesthetic masterpiece; it's a versatile element that will find its home across various facets of our game. From the main menu to the credits, and as a grand finale in our soon-to-be-released trailer, this 'infinite animation' feature is set to become a signature aspect of our game, offering a lasting impression in every scenario. Get ready to be part of a world where every moment is an epic spectacle, a testament to the breathtaking journey that awaits in our game
Artwork by https://www.artstation.com/adrieng

notes.title: Extreme customization: display your colors
notes.content:
[h1]Unleash Your Banner![/h1]

Forge your in-game identity by creating a custom banner that truly represents you. With countless combinations, no two guilds will ever look the same. Stand out and make your mark!

[h1]Raid in Style[/h1]

Let your emblem shine! Regardless of class, each raider will proudly display your chosen symbol. While certain colors remain consistent for elements like leather, skin, and armor, the rest draw inspiration directly from your personalized banner. Here's a sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/c7cd0dd450d2b13264abf5831552e7566f19c7cf.gif[/img]


[h1]Something Exciting on the Horizon...[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/0b39c306042e759cbc597968947aaa2c871b92d5.png[/img]
We've caught a glimpse of the drafts for our new Steam capsule. They're looking spectacular! But we thought it'd be more thrilling to give them a pixelated shroud for now. Keep an eye out; the big reveal isn't too far away!

notes.title: From concept to (virtual) reality
notes.content:
[h1]Ranger[/h1]

Ranger was not our first raider in term of concept art. In fact we started with Warrior. But it was technically the best option for us. So we start modeling Ranger. The first of its kind !

[h1]Raw model[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/f04178727e6f204cdc8a72a96e6e3fc755d99a59.png[/img]

Introducing the RANGER in its raw version. It is highly optimized for our strategic video game needs, boasting a limited number of vertices. Yet, we are extremely pleased with the outcome and the high-quality appearance of the model!

[h1]Textured model[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/fb7d58c5e87a7ba365befca8b6ae8092141982c7.png[/img]

This model interacts seamlessly with animations, and I can't wait to show you a version with an animated GIF. It's also textured precisely how we envisioned. And, in case you weren't aware, all our units will adopt the color of your banner... More on this topic soon...

notes.title: More concept art + playtest
notes.content:
[h3]Internal playtest[/h3]
This week we did some playtest with our demo and made great progress. Of course there is still a lot of works but the update is closer than never.

[h3]Priest (raider)[/h3]
BEHOLD : our priest. It’s a support class but can also inflict damage. Priest can summon an “Healing Orb” to heal other raiders that touch it. There is also a buff that synergises with the other skills of raiders.

Are you in love yet ?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/d2581cfe5989b8e9004e0520057bf36a2f419bee.png[/img]

notes.title: Concept art + new demo incoming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/29083d9b36166a1fa0d28ab43e57185e9f303ddf.png[/img]

[h3]Feedback[/h3]
Since our last steam fest, we had a lot of feedback and we are working hard to deliver the best possible experience. After hard work we are glad to finally announce a brand new demo that will be delivered soon.

[h3]New demo incoming[/h3]
We almost remade our game, boss fight and city management will merge to have a true 4X gameplay (Exploration, Exterminate, Expand, Exploit).

[h3]Warrior (raider)[/h3]
Here are concept art for our new raider class “Warrior”. A melee class that will do damage whirling and can execute boss when they are low on health point. In the first one you can see your guild banner literrally paint over his body.

[i]Who is your favorite ?[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42043148/19a13a928654e0dec46eee17d718ccf083108463.png[/img]
